decision_flags.title: Unstable angina managed with next-week cardiology?
decision_flags.concern: The working diagnosis is unstable angina, which usually warrants same-day emergency evaluation with troponin, yet the plan is an outpatient cardiology visit and stress test next week. The history as given (exertional pressure for three months, relieved by rest) reads more like stable angina, so the label and the disposition do not match.
decision_flags.consider: You might clarify whether the pattern is stable or unstable and, if truly unstable, consider same-day ED referral and troponin; if stable, consider documenting it as stable angina with urgent outpatient workup.
